title: Russian Work Visa from the UK | Work Permit & Apply
description: Russian work visa for UK residents: work permit, employer invitation, HIV certificate and how the visa is extended in Russia. We help you apply.
h1: Russian work visa from the UK
intro: The Russian work visa is for taking a job in Russia. Your employer arranges your work permit and official invitation first. We prepare your visa application and check your documents.
eligibility: You have a job offer from an employer in Russia
Your employer has arranged a work permit and official invitation
You have an HIV test certificate

sections.heading: UK government travel advice
sections.text: The UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) currently advises against all travel to Russia. If you travel against this advice, your travel insurance may not be valid, and the UK's ability to help you in Russia is very limited. Please read the [latest FCDO advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/russia) before you book.

sections.heading: How the Russian work visa works
sections.text: Your employer applies for your work permit and invitation through the Russian migration authorities. With the invitation, you apply for your work visa. The first visa is usually single entry for 90 days, and your employer then extends it in Russia for the length of your work permit.

sections.heading: Highly qualified specialists
sections.text: Senior and specialist staff may qualify for a highly qualified specialist (HQS) work permit, which is usually quicker and longer. Your employer will know which applies to you.

sections.heading: Russian work visa help in Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help with Russian work visa applications for clients across the UK. Most applications can be handled by post and email, so you don't need to visit us in person.

faqs.q: Who arranges the Russian work permit?
faqs.a: Your employer in Russia, through the Russian migration authorities.

faqs.q: Can I start work on a business visa?
faqs.a: No. Paid work in Russia needs a work visa.

faqs.q: Does the UK government advise against travel to Russia?
faqs.a: Yes. The FCDO currently advises against all travel to Russia. Check the latest advice on GOV.UK before making plans.
